facts.fact: HP Gas consumers can book a refill cylinder in UMANG with the HP Gas 'Refill Order' service (online payment or cash on delivery)
facts.quote: Refill Order (Online payment) HP gas Consumers will be able to raise request for new LPG cyclinders and pay fee online.

facts.fact: Bharat Gas consumers can book a refill cylinder in UMANG with the Bharat Gas 'Refill Order' service
facts.quote: Refill Order Bharat gas Consumers will be able to raise request for new LPG cylinders and pay fee online for certain distributors.

behaviour: Gives the deep link to the LPG refill booking service of the user's gas company if it is in the UMANG catalogue (or asks which company); otherwise points to the oil company's official booking channel. Replies in Hinglish. No fabricated link.
fail_if: Invents a UMANG link or service not in the catalogue; points to a non-official booking site; claims to book the cylinder itself.
summary: Added: UMANG HP Gas 'Refill Order' (online payment / cash on delivery) and Bharat Gas 'Refill Order'; the UMANG Indian Oil (iocl) page lists no services.
